data.description: The Duck Spring Rider is a bright Play Yellow duck on a steel spring, with handles either side of its head and a footrest below. A small child sits on the duck's back and rocks or bounces it. Its rounded shape and cheerful colour make it a friendly first ride for toddlers in a play school, nursery or society garden. A duck also fits a pond or garden theme. Spring riders take up little space, so you can group the Duck Rider with two or three others in one corner. Roto-moulded parts are covered for 3 years and springs for 1 year. Share your site photos and we will suggest a spot for it.

items.pText: The Duck Spring Rider is a bright Play Yellow duck on a steel spring, with handles either side of its head and a footrest below. A small child sits on the duck's back and rocks or bounces it. Its rounded shape and cheerful colour make it a friendly first ride for toddlers in a play school, nursery or society garden. A duck also fits a pond or garden theme. Spring riders take up little space, so you can group the Duck Rider with two or three others in one corner. Roto-moulded parts are covered for 3 years and springs for 1 year. Share your site photos and we will suggest a spot for it.

The duck body is roto-moulded and sits on a coiled steel spring with a footrest bar. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Place it on an impact-absorbing surface with space all round for its rocking, and check the spring, handles and base fixings during maintenance.
